title: Federation: peer auth via RFC 9421 signatures
description: Spec text for Mark's decision chinwag-nuqe.6 (2026-10-19): peer = domain. Baseline MUST: every Peer/* request signed with RFC 9421 HTTP Message Signatures; signing public key published in the server's /.well-known/jmap Session, fetched over WebPKI-validated HTTPS. SHOULD where DNSSEC is available: same key in DNSSEC-signed DNS (TLSA or DKIM-style TXT), which takes precedence over the HTTPS key. MAY: mutual TLS with a (possibly self-signed) client cert verified against the sender domain's DNSSEC-signed TLSA record (cf. RFC 7672; draft-ietf-dance-client-auth: check status before citing). Details to specify (each a choice for Mark): key format and ids, rotation/overlap, covered components (@method, @target-uri, content-digest per RFC 9530, created/expires), clock skew and replay window, key cache TTL and refetch on unknown keyid, how the authenticated domain binds to senderUserId identities (identity forms without a host, e.g. did:key). Edit draft-atwood-jmap-chat-federation-00 §Peer Authentication Model and related Session/Security text. Unblocks chinwag-nuqe.7.
notes:
Mark 2026-10-19 sign-off on draft (wf_9bd0e166-c24): (1) identity binding = host check (identity host == verified peer domain, exact; DIDs via DID draft verification; other host-less forms rejected; E2EE relay opaque identity carries the relay domain as host) + carve-out in draft-atwood-jmap-chat-00 L217/L429 allowing federation peer authentication to extract the host; (2) DNSSEC lookup failure (SERVFAIL/timeout, indeterminate) falls back to the HTTPS-published key; only a bogus (validation-failed) answer rejects; (3) the other 16 editorial choices accepted as drafted (Ed25519 only, kid = RFC 7638 thumbprint, keyid <domain>#<kid>, tag jmap-chat-peer, components @method @target-uri content-digest + created/expires/nonce, 300 s window, 60 s skew, nonce cache, 1 h key cache, refetch on unknown kid <=1/60 s, rotation windows, TXT _jmap-peer thumbprint record, 403, port 443 A-label domains, HTTPS-only redirects, public unsigned discovery GET incl. ownerUserId+peerSigningKeys, IANA _jmap-peer). Plus: unknown-kid refetch also re-queries DNS; align 'authenticated identity' wording to 'peer identity'.
Mark 2026-10-19 round 3: (1) compliance 7.17 steps prefaced with cache-expiry / >60 s since last fetch; (2) DNS requery trigger = kid not among the USABLE keys; (3) 'verified identity' -> 'peer identity' (~L401, ~L807); (4) add compliance test for the unknown-kid DNS requery; (5) receivers using the DNSSEC binding MUST validate themselves or obtain validation over a trusted channel; otherwise treat every zone as unsigned. Then commit and push (approved).
